shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text TextInput Label'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text TextInput Label && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head -90 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts && rg -n 'YfmStaticView|RenderPreview' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -45 && rg -n 'transform\\(|needToSanitizeHtml|allowHTML' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md | head -22"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist && sed -n '53,112p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.d.ts | head -90 && rg -n 'renderPreview' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle -g '*.js' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.css | head -95"
/bin/bash -lc "cat vite.config.ts && npm ls punycode && rg -n 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'process|cwd' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js && rg -n -C 2 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js && rg -n 'process|punycode|polyfill' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md && cat index.html && git diff --stat"
